companyNotes: Seibu Prince Hotels and Resorts is a global hotel group with more than 90 locations worldwide, focused on hospitality, travel experiences, brand growth, and a goal to expand to 250 hotels worldwide.
jobDescription: Website Developer or Website Master role in Bangkok with hybrid work. Responsibilities include managing and maintaining corporate and hotel websites, keeping websites secure, optimized, compliant, responsive, and aligned with brand standards and commercial objectives. The role includes website health, performance, security, updates, uptime, templates, design systems, new pages, landing pages, microsites, campaigns, promotions, content updates, AWS hosting, domains, SSL certificates, stakeholder support, SEO, analytics, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, reporting, revenue performance, and collaboration with commercial, revenue, sales, marketing, hotel teams, external developers, vendors, hosting providers, and agencies.
letter: I am interested in the Website Developer role at Seibu Prince Hotels and Resorts (Thailand) because it connects well with my full-stack background and my interest in building web systems that support real business goals. The hospitality focus of Seibu Prince Hotels and Resorts is especially meaningful to me because a hotel website is not only a technical platform, but also an important part of the guest experience, brand trust, and direct revenue journey.

In my current work as a Software Engineer, I build and maintain backend services, support web application delivery, manage cloud-based deployment work, and help keep production systems stable. I work with technologies such as React, Node.js, AWS, Docker, and CI/CD practices, but the main value of this experience is learning how to deliver reliable digital products, troubleshoot issues, and improve systems after they are released.

What attracts me most to this role is the mix of website development, day-to-day maintenance, performance improvement, content support, and coordination with commercial and hotel teams. I would enjoy helping maintain secure and responsive websites, supporting new pages and campaign launches, improving user experience, and using website data to guide practical improvements. While my strongest experience has been in full-stack engineering and cloud operations, I am also motivated to deepen my work with WordPress, SEO, analytics, tracking, and digital governance in a hospitality environment.

I would welcome the opportunity to contribute to Seibu Prince Hotels and Resorts as the team continues to grow its brand portfolio and digital presence. Thank you for considering my application. I would be glad to discuss how my software engineering, cloud, DevOps, and web development background can support this role.
